create_type_checker_for_field: create a TypeChecker instance by calling GetTypeChecker with a FieldDescriptor to validate field values
check_int32_value: check an int32 value by calling Int32ValueChecker CheckValue to validate type and range bounds
check_enum_value: check an enum value by calling EnumValueChecker CheckValue to verify the value exists in the enum type
check_unicode_string_value: check a unicode string value by calling UnicodeValueChecker CheckValue to validate UTF-8 encoding
lookup_encoder_for_type: lookup an encoder constructor by accessing TYPE_TO_ENCODER with a FieldDescriptor type constant
